title: Wait for tenant feedback after sending troubleshooting instructions

semantic_requirements.description: State that the switch check has already been requested and tenant confirmation is pending.
Do not claim that a reply has been received or the fault resolved.

prohibited_behaviors: Assigning a contractor before receiving troubleshooting feedback.

input_evidence.excerpt: There is a switch to the righthand side of the hob when needs to be switched on.

Address: Flat 1, 31 Juniper Mews, Cedarford, ZZ7 7ZZ

Good afternoon Clara,

I trust you are well.

The landlord has advised that there is a switch to the right-hand side of the hob which needs to be switched on. Please could you check this and let me know if everything is working correctly?

Kind regards,
Imogen
Northbridge Lettings

reference_actions.excerpt: Landlord suggested tenant check on the right hand of the hob there should be a switch. Awaiting tenant response.
